<a name="HookBuilder"></a>
## type [HookBuilder](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/hooks.go#L20-L22>)

HookBuilder provides a fluent API for registering and invoking hook providers.

Obtain via \[Application.Hooks\]:

```
app.Hooks().Set("render:toolbar", func() any { return myView })
app.Hooks().Add("app.sidebar", func() any { return sidebarItem })
```

Alternative — direct registry access \(e.g. inside a plugin\):

```
var hooks hook.Registry
app.Make(&hooks)
hooks.Set("render:toolbar", myProvider)
```

```go [hooks.go]
type HookBuilder struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="HookBuilder.Add"></a>
### func \(\*HookBuilder\) [Add](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/hooks.go#L62>)

```go [hooks.go]
func (h *HookBuilder) Add(name string, provider hook.Provider) *HookBuilder
```

Add registers a provider for a multi\-slot hook. All registered providers are called in registration order and their results collected.

Fluent style:

```
app.Hooks().Add("app.sidebar", func() any {
    return mySidebarItem
})
```

Alternative \(direct registry\):

```
var hooks hook.Registry
app.Make(&hooks)
hooks.Add("app.sidebar", provider)
```

<a name="HookBuilder.All"></a>
### func \(\*HookBuilder\) [All](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/hooks.go#L106>)

```go [hooks.go]
func (h *HookBuilder) All(name string) []any
```

All invokes all registered providers for the given multi\-slot hook and returns their results in registration order. Returns nil if no providers are registered.

Fluent style:

```
items := app.Hooks().All("app.sidebar")
```

Alternative \(direct registry\):

```
var hooks hook.Registry
app.Make(&hooks)
items := hooks.All("app.sidebar")
```

<a name="HookBuilder.Get"></a>
### func \(\*HookBuilder\) [Get](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/hooks.go#L89>)

```go [hooks.go]
func (h *HookBuilder) Get(name string) any
```

Get invokes the registered provider for the given single\-slot hook and returns its result. Returns nil if no provider is registered.

Fluent style:

```
toolbar := app.Hooks().Get("render:toolbar")
```

Alternative \(direct registry\):

```
var hooks hook.Registry
app.Make(&hooks)
toolbar := hooks.Get("render:toolbar")
```


Register registers a provider with an explicit cardinality. Prefer [HookBuilder.Set](<#HookBuilder.Set>) or [HookBuilder.Add](<#HookBuilder.Add>) for clarity.

<a name="HookBuilder.Set"></a>
### func \(\*HookBuilder\) [Set](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/hooks.go#L43>)

```go [hooks.go]
func (h *HookBuilder) Set(name string, provider hook.Provider) *HookBuilder
```

Set registers a provider for a single\-slot hook. Only one provider is expected; if multiple are registered a warning is logged and the first wins.

Fluent style:

```
app.Hooks().Set("render:toolbar", func() any {
    return myToolbarView
})
```

Alternative \(direct registry\):

```
var hooks hook.Registry
app.Make(&hooks)
hooks.Set("render:toolbar", provider)
```

<a name="KeyBuilder"></a>
## type [KeyBuilder](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/keys.go#L27-L29>)

KeyBuilder provides a fluent API for registering global keybindings.

Obtain via \[Application.Keys\]:

```
// Single key
app.Keys().Bind("ctrl+q", handler)

// Multiple aliases
app.Keys().Bind([]string{"j", "down"}, handler)

// Zone-scoped key (stack level 0)
app.Keys().Zone("main").Bind("esc", handler)

// Zone-scoped key with explicit stack level
app.Keys().Zone("modal", 1).Bind("esc", handler)
```

Alternative \(direct registry access\):

```
app.Router().Registry().RegisterGlobal("ctrl+q", handler)
app.Router().Registry().RegisterZone(0, "main", "esc", handler)
```

```go [keys.go]
type KeyBuilder struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```


<a name="KeyBuilder.Bind"></a>
### func \(\*KeyBuilder\) [Bind](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/keys.go#L47>)

```go [keys.go]
func (b *KeyBuilder) Bind(key any, handler func()) *KeyBuilder
```

Bind registers a global keybinding that fires regardless of the focused zone. key may be a string or \[\]string to register multiple aliases for the same action.

Fluent style:

```
app.Keys().Bind("ctrl+q", func() { app.Shutdown() })
app.Keys().Bind([]string{"?", "ctrl+/"}, showHelp)
```

Alternative \(direct registry\):

```
app.Router().Registry().RegisterGlobal("ctrl+q", handler)
```

<a name="KeyBuilder.Zone"></a>
### func \(\*KeyBuilder\) [Zone](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/keys.go#L59>)

```go [keys.go]
func (b *KeyBuilder) Zone(zone string, level ...int) *ZoneKeyBuilder
```

Zone returns a [ZoneKeyBuilder](<#ZoneKeyBuilder>) scoped to the given zone name. An optional stack level can be provided \(defaults to 0\).

```
app.Keys().Zone("main").Bind("j", moveDown)
app.Keys().Zone("modal", 1).Bind("esc", closeModal)
```

<a name="MouseBuilder"></a>
## type [MouseBuilder](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/mouse.go#L26-L28>)

MouseBuilder provides a fluent API for registering mouse hitboxes and handlers.

Obtain via \[Application.Mouse\]:

```
// Register hitbox (call every render cycle)
app.Mouse().UpdateHitbox("sidebar", x, y, width, height)

// Register handlers
app.Mouse().Zone("sidebar").OnClick(func(x, y int) {
    // sidebar was clicked at (x, y)
})

app.Mouse().Zone("panel").OnDrop(func(from string, x, y int) {
    // item dragged from 'from' zone was dropped here
})

// Explicit stack level (e.g. overlay at level 1)
app.Mouse().Zone("modal-btn", 1).OnClick(func(x, y int) { ... })
```

```go [mouse.go]
type MouseBuilder struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="MouseBuilder.UpdateHitbox"></a>
### func \(\*MouseBuilder\) [UpdateHitbox](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/mouse.go#L40>)

```go [mouse.go]
func (b *MouseBuilder) UpdateHitbox(zoneID string, x, y, width, height int) *MouseBuilder
```

UpdateHitbox sets the on\-screen bounding box for a zone at stack level 0 \(base\). Call this every render cycle with the zone's current position and dimensions so the router can perform accurate hit\-testing.

```
app.Mouse().UpdateHitbox("sidebar", x, y, width, height)
```

### func \(\*MouseBuilder\) [UpdateHitboxAt](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/mouse.go#L50>)

```go [mouse.go]
func (b *MouseBuilder) UpdateHitboxAt(stackLevel int, zoneID string, x, y, width, height int) *MouseBuilder
```

UpdateHitboxAt sets the on\-screen bounding box for a zone at an explicit stack level.

```
app.Mouse().UpdateHitboxAt(1, "modal-btn", x, y, width, height)
```

<a name="MouseBuilder.Zone"></a>
### func \(\*MouseBuilder\) [Zone](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/mouse.go#L62>)

```go [mouse.go]
func (b *MouseBuilder) Zone(zone string, level ...int) *ZoneMouseBuilder
```

Zone returns a [ZoneMouseBuilder](<#ZoneMouseBuilder>) scoped to the given zone name. An optional stack level can be provided \(defaults to 0\).

```

app.Mouse().Zone("modal", 1).OnRightClick(handler)
```

## type [ZoneKeyBuilder](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/keys.go#L69-L73>)

ZoneKeyBuilder provides a fluent API for registering keybindings scoped to a specific zone and stack level.

```go [keys.go]
type ZoneKeyBuilder struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="ZoneKeyBuilder.Bind"></a>
### func \(\*ZoneKeyBuilder\) [Bind](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/builders/keys.go#L86>)

```go [keys.go]
func (z *ZoneKeyBuilder) Bind(key any, handler func()) *ZoneKeyBuilder
```

Bind registers a keybinding scoped to this zone and stack level. key may be a string or \[\]string for aliases.

Fluent style:

```
app.Keys().Zone("main").Bind("j", moveDown)
app.Keys().Zone("main").Bind([]string{"k", "up"}, moveUp)
```

Alternative \(direct registry\):

```
app.Router().Registry().RegisterZone(0, "main", "j", moveDown)
```
